title: its-checks saved project intent
description: Intended integrations, automation, and project-specific input answers for one target package. This is not proof of successful installation and contains no ownership inventory. Repository: https://github.com/ItsEthanDev/its-checks
$comment: Source repository: https://github.com/ItsEthanDev/its-checks. Fork authors should update this link. The generator pins each generated file's $schema URL to source.revision; no runtime fetch is required.

$schema.description: HTTPS raw JSON Schema URL at the immutable generating revision. Must match source repository, revision, and selectionSchema; this equality is checked offline by the installer.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the saved-intent data format.

source.description: Editable generator identity copied from policy/bundle.json, not inferred from the target project.

repository.description: Generator source repository URL. Credentials, query strings, and fragments are rejected by the installer.

revision.description: Full immutable Git commit containing this schema and identifying the generating policy. Branch names and tags are not accepted.

selectionSchema.description: Safe repository-relative POSIX path to this JSON Schema, normally schemas/selections.schema.json. Absolute/traversing paths and unsafe portable filename components are rejected by the installer.

integrations.description: Integration directory IDs to preselect in the next dialogue; not automatic selections.

automation.description: Automation directory IDs to preselect in the next dialogue; not installation status.

additionalProperties.description: Answers keyed by declared input ID. Paths are strings relative to the target package; their existence is not required. Input-specific type/path validation uses the current selected declarations.

answers.description: Answers namespaced by base, integrations/<id>, or automation/<id>, used only for dialogue prefill. Fresh output contains only currently selected, declared inputs.

id.description: Stable lowercase directory or input ID, optionally separated by hyphens.
